reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text:
Es la primera vez que utilizo un limpiador en aceite y me ha gustado mucho. No deja sensación grasosa y emulsiona muy bien, es mi primer paso de limpieza en las noches.

Tengo piel seca con tendencia acnéica (al parecer es hormonal) y no me brotó la cara, me ha ayudado con mis puntos negros y piel muerta. 

Como punto a considerar, es que tiene fragancia; me imagino que porque el olor a aceite para muchos no es agradable, pero para mí no ha sido problema.
reviews.zh:
係我第一次用卸妝油，覺得好滿意。佢唔會有油笠嘅感覺，乳化得好徹底，係我夜晚嘅第一步潔面。

我係乾性肌但有暗瘡傾向（好似係荷爾蒙引起嘅），用咗之後冇爆瘡，對我處理黑頭同死皮都好有幫助。

要留意嘅係佢有香味，我估係因為好多人都覺得油味唔好聞，所以加咗香味，但對我嚟講冇影響。

reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text:
The product is cleaning well and i could feel the dirts going out of my pores and my pores greatly reduced in seize. There is a lot of product in the bottle in 1 month of daily use im not even at 1/4 of the bottle took. 

That said i feel like using it when i have a really oily face feels weird so i end up alterning cleaning products when i have oily face. 

It also go nice to remove a bit of makeup, i mistaked it once for my makeup remover and the makeup still went out nicely even on the eyes and my eyes werent burning.
reviews.zh:
呢件產品清潔力好強，我感覺到毛孔入面嘅污垢被清走咗，毛孔都明顯細咗。一樽好多嘢，我日日用一個月都未用完四分一。

不過當我塊面好油嘅時候用佢，會覺得有啲怪，所以我最後會喺面油嗰陣轉用其他潔面產品。

佢卸少量妝都好好用，我有次唔小心攞咗佢當卸妝水用，妝都卸得好乾淨，連眼妝都搞得掂，眼睛又唔會覺得刺痛。

reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: I’m always on the look out for oil cleansers being I love doing a double cleanse so when I saw this brand trending on social media and they had an oil cleanser, I had to give it a try. Personally I don’t think it’s any different from your typical watery oil cleanser. It does the trick and cleanses well and easily, however I’m personally not a fan of the scent. It’s a bit too florally for me, but it doesn’t last very long and my skin hasn’t reacted to it. The texture is very watery and emulsifies well and it doesn’t leave a film behind after washing it off. I haven’t really noticed any changes in my pores after using this so I can’t really say anything about it but it’s definitely not making my pores worse.
reviews.zh: 我一向都會留意新出嘅卸妝油，因為我好鍾意做 double cleanse，當我見到呢個牌子喺社交媒體上好 hit，而且佢哋有出卸妝油，我就即刻試吓。個人嚟講我唔覺得佢同一般嘅水狀卸妝油有咩分別。佢做到應有嘅功效，潔淨度好夠又易用，不過我自己就唔太鍾意個味道，對我嚟講花香感重咗少少，但係味道唔算持久，皮膚都冇不良反應。質感好水，乳化效果好好，洗完之後唔會有膜感。我用咗之後毛孔方面冇乜明顯變化，所以呢方面我冇乜好講，但肯定冇令到我毛孔變差。

reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: I've been using this product for a month and I'm super disappointed :( I bought the Anua cleansing oil and cleanser together and after using it for about 3 weeks I'm just going to stop washing my face all together until I get new cleansers. I've always had decently clear skin, just some problems here and there with clogged pores or hyperpigmentation. But since using these cleansers I broke out BADLY. Painful pimples are all over my forehead and between my brows, lots of texture and small pimples on my cheeks, and incredibly over sensitized skin. My skin has reacted poorly to some products in the past but never like this.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢件產品一個月，超級失望 :( 我一齊買咗 Anua 嘅卸妝油同洗面奶，用咗大約三個禮拜之後，我索性連面都唔洗住，直到買到新嘅潔面產品為止。我本身皮膚一直都好乾淨，間中有少少毛孔堵塞或者色素沉澱嘅問題。但係自從用咗呢兩件潔面產品之後，我爆瘡爆得好嚴重。額頭同眉心生滿痛嘅暗瘡，兩邊面頰都有好多細粒暗瘡，仲搞到皮膚敏感到不得了。以前用其他產品皮膚都有試過不良反應，但都唔似今次咁嚴重。

reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text:
I love the product itself but not sure how much of a difference it makes! I think its not noticeable to me personally. I know some others said it helped reduce white heads etc. If it did that for me, only a little. But still, I enjoy the two step process and I do notice it helps remove oil deposits on my face. The strong is peculiar, very rosemary smell, or perhaps like sourdough 😂

It did not break me out though so can”t complain!
reviews.zh:
我本身鍾意呢件產品，但係唔肯定佢有幾大效果！對我嚟講，我覺得唔算好明顯。我見到有其他人話佢可以幫助減少白頭等等，對我就好少。不過我依然鍾意做兩步清潔嘅過程，而且我發現佢真係可以幫我清走面上嘅油垢。味道好特別，好濃嘅迷迭香味，或者好似 sourdough 咁 😂

不過佢冇令我爆瘡，所以冇咩好投訴！

reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: finally got to try this after hearing sooo many ppl talk abt it. while it’s good at taking off my makeup, it is quite a heavy oil compared to other ones ive tried. bc of this, i feel like my combo skin isn’t reacting too well to it. ive noticed a few pimples pop up since using it, which is making me want to stop😭 i def like the skin1004 one better, but this one i feel will be good for ppl with drier skin.
reviews.zh: 聽咗好多人講咗好耐，終於有機會試吓。佢卸妝能力係好嘅，但比起我試過嘅其他卸妝油，呢款比較油身。正因如此，我覺得自己嘅混合性肌膚用落反應唔係太好。自從用咗之後我發現出咗幾粒暗瘡，搞到我想停用 😭 我肯定 skin1004 嗰款好用啲，但呢款我覺得會啱啲皮膚乾嘅人用。

reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: Do not reccomend for sensitive skin, fragrance is very high up on the ingredient list. My face turned bright red the first time I used it and I was red for a few days afterwards. Besides that I don't even think it removed my sebacious filaments all that well. I bought it because of TikTok and failed to do my own research before making the purchase. People coming from TikTok beware!!
reviews.zh: 敏感肌嘅人千祈唔好用，成分表入面香精排得好前。我第一次用完塊面就紅到不得了，之後幾日都仲係紅住。除此之外我覺得佢連我嘅皮脂線都清得唔算好徹底。當初係因為喺 TikTok 見到就買，冇做功課就衝動入手。從 TikTok 入坑嘅人小心啲呀！！

reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: I really loved this cleanser, I felt the dirt grinding up against my hands and saw some blackheads too, which was satisfying! It is now one of my favorite cleanser to use when getting dirt off effectively. Truly a holy grail, in my opinion at least, Will be repurchasing this!! Hopefully it works well for others!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢支洗面奶，我 feel 到啲污垢喺我手上磨沙嘅感覺，仲睇到有啲黑頭，感覺好治癒！而家佢已經成為我最鍾意用嚟深層清潔嘅洗面奶之一。至少對我嚟講真係神級產品，一定會回購！！希望其他人用都覺得好用！
